description: Defines the ElidedLabel class, a custom Qt widget for displaying text with elision (truncation with ellipsis). It includes properties, signals, and private members related to text display and elision state.

classes.name: ElidedLabel
classes.description: A Qt widget subclassing QFrame that displays text with optional elision, providing properties for text content and elision state, and a signal to notify changes.

methods.name: ElidedLabel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the widget with optional parent and text.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the label.

methods.name: isElided
methods.description: Returns whether the text is currently elided.

methods.name: paintEvent
methods.description: Handles the painting of the widget, including text rendering with elision.
